lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like 2D lattice posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows to form coordinates for the high-luminance blobs.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features running along the flank, each defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense distribution of small, lower-contrast spots that are significantly smaller in diameter than the primary flank blobs.
